description: Native auto-translated caption languages for YouTube 21.20.405. Remembered language and native selection.

patches.name: Universal Captions - unlock translation languages (experimental)
patches.description: Adds YouTube-native auto-translation targets to Android captions menu. No AI or external translation API.

release_notes: Adds native auto-translation language options and remembers subtitle language or Off across videos. Prefers target-language manual captions, then ASR; otherwise selects a suitable native track for YouTube translation. Tested on YouTube 21.20.405 with Waydroid; other versions and edge cases unverified. No external translation API.
